categories.description: Adjusting or repairing existing clothing: hemming, taking in or letting out, resizing, and zipper or button replacement. Making new garments is Sewing.
Mechanical vehicle maintenance and repair, such as oil changes, brakes, batteries, tires, and diagnostics. Cosmetic vehicle cleaning is Car Detailing.
Occasional, short-term child supervision, such as a single evening, date night, or a few hours. Regular, ongoing care is Childcare.
Cosmetic vehicle cleaning: interior vacuuming and upholstery shampooing, exterior washing, waxing, and polishing. Mechanical work is Automotive.
Custom woodwork and wood repair: building, cutting, fitting, or fixing shelves, cabinets, trim, doors, decks, and wooden furniture parts. Assembling flat-pack furniture is Furniture Assembly.
Food prepared and served for events and gatherings, such as parties, weddings, and office functions. Everyday household meals are Cooking.
Regular, ongoing child care, such as a nanny, daily or weekly care, or after-school care. A one-off short session is Babysitting.
Cleaning homes and offices: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, kitchens, bathrooms, deep cleaning, and move-out cleaning. Decluttering and arranging belongings is Organizing.
Diagnosing and fixing laptop or desktop hardware and software faults, such as failure to start, part replacement, virus removal, and data recovery. Setting up other devices is Tech Support.
Preparing everyday meals for a household, such as a personal chef or weekly meal prep. Food service for events is Catering.
Picking up and transporting individual items, such as packages, purchases, or a single piece of furniture. Relocating a whole household is Moving.
Scheduled walks and exercise outings for dogs. Feeding, sitting, or other care for pets is Pet Care.

Structured teaching, courses, and group learning, including language lessons such as English or Spanish and adult skills classes. One-to-one academic help is Tutoring; instrument lessons are Music Lessons.
Electrician work: wiring, outlets, switches, light fixtures, ceiling fans, breaker panels, and electrical fault repair. Configuring connected devices is Smart Home.
Live performers for events, such as DJs, live musicians, bands, magicians, and party entertainers.
Running everyday errands for someone: grocery shopping, picking up prescriptions or dry cleaning, returns, and waiting in line.
Group or general exercise instruction, such as yoga, pilates, and workout classes. Individual one-to-one coaching is Personal Training.
Assembling and installing ready-made or flat-pack furniture from supplied parts, such as beds, wardrobes, desks, and bookcases. Building or repairing wood is Carpentry.
Caring for existing plants and gardens: watering, pruning, weeding, planting, and lawn mowing. Designing or building outdoor spaces is Landscaping.
Upgrades and renovations that change a home, such as remodeling, new flooring, tiling, or installing new features. Fixing something broken is Home Repair.
Handyman fixes for broken or worn household items, such as hinges, doors, drywall holes, and minor maintenance.
Designing and building outdoor spaces: landscape design, new lawns or sod, patios, hardscaping, and outdoor installations. Routine plant care is Gardening.
Relocating a household or office: packing, loading, transporting, and unloading belongings.
Instruction in playing instruments or singing, such as piano, guitar, violin, drums, and voice, and music theory. Live performance at events is Entertainment.
Decluttering and arranging belongings in homes and offices, such as closets, garages, and storage systems.
Interior and exterior painting of walls, rooms, ceilings, trim, and fences, including surface preparation.
Administrative and day-to-day personal support, such as scheduling, email, bookings, and paperwork organization.
Individual one-to-one fitness coaching and personalized exercise programs. Group classes are Fitness.
Non-medical care for pets: feeding, pet sitting, boarding, grooming, and supervision. Dog walks are Dog Walking; veterinary treatment is not offered.
Still photography of people, properties, products, and events, such as portraits, headshots, and wedding photos. Video recording is Videography.
Pipes, faucets, taps, toilets, drains, water heaters, and leaks: installation and repair.
Making new garments and fabric items from scratch, such as custom clothing, curtains, and costumes, and fabric repairs. Adjusting existing clothing is Alterations.
Installing and configuring connected home devices, such as smart thermostats, video doorbells, smart lights, and home automation hubs.
Setting up and troubleshooting consumer technology, such as phones, tablets, printers, Wi-Fi, TVs, and software accounts. Repairing broken computers is Computer Repair.
One-to-one academic help with school subjects, homework, and test preparation. Language and group classes are Education.
Professional video recording, filming, and editing for events, businesses, and personal projects. Still photos are Photography.
